name: codex-autoresearch
description: One Codex skill for measured autoresearch loops: set up or resume, run packets, log decisions, use the live dashboard, and finalize kept changes.

interface.shortDescription: Run measured Codex loops from one plugin skill
interface.longDescription: Codex Autoresearch gives Codex one skill surface for the full loop: onboard a human or AI agent, start or resume a measured session with one next safe action, lint benchmark METRIC output, convert deep research into quality_gap checkpoints, run next packets with evidence bundles, log keep/discard/measure/crash/checks_failed decisions with ASI and promotion labels, keep the live readout open, and split kept work into clean review branches.
defaultPrompt: @Codex Autoresearch plan a measured loop from this prompt.
@Codex Autoresearch serve the live dashboard when useful.
